The institutional investor held 815,050 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $62.32 million, up from 799,350 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Turtle Creek Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Tjx Companies Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $53.07B market cap company. The stock increased 0.69% or $0.58 $84.65.
